items.conversion_notes:
# PB100087_P1.1 conversion record

Source: timed:/files/TIMED_MOAC_LGCP_EXP01/PB100087_P1.1_2026-06-05_14.46.25
Converted: 2026-09-08, convert_plate.py, cellprompter-cpu.sif

- 88,704 single-plane LZW TIFFs (2500x2500 uint16) -> 616 sharded Zarr arrays
- One array per (well, site), shape (48, 3, 2500, 2500), axes t/c/y/x
- Channels in index order: 405, 505, 625 nm
- chunks (1,1,625,625), shard = whole array, blosc-zstd clevel 5, shuffle
- 755 GiB -> 562.2 GiB (1.34x vs LZW, 1.83x vs raw)
- Pixels unmodified; bit-exact roundtrip verified on 6 random planes
- No illumination correction applied. Corrections are a separate, later step.

Acquisition (from config.json; P1.1 differs from the other 7 plates):
- ViewPlate 384-well, 2.9 mm bottom offset, site spacing 0.7 mm
- 405: 20 ms / 15 dB, 505: 290 ms / 20 dB, 625: 350 ms / 15 dB, illum 100%
- Plates P1.2-P2.4 use PhenoPlate, 0.328 mm, 20/350/250 ms, 13/20/15 dB

QC from instrument metadata:
- autofocus Success on 88,695 planes; N/A on 9
  (I02 s1 t3; K04 s1 t1-t2 -- all channels, stage_z within normal range)
- t0->t1 median interval 59:59.2
